studies.title: The chili pepper
studies.caption: Small peppers ripen among the leaves. Seeds carried from the Americas helped make chili part of everyday cooking across much of Asia and Africa.
studies.prompt: Eye-level botanical branch study of Capsicum annuum, narrow simple leaves, small white five-lobed flowers and slender red and green chili fruits attached by their calyx and stems. Restrained natural red accents, no bell peppers or black pepper berries.
